subject: Floating indicators
notes: kb/Work PB1359 landed: the floating literal continuation indicator is recognized in ONE place (LogicalLineBuilder, both reference formats) for alphanumeric, boolean (B, BX) and national (N, NX) literals, hexadecimal alphanumeric included; 'A given literal shall not be continued with more than one form of continuation' is COBOL2687 (a hyphen in column 7 after a floating indicator, or after a literal a floating indicator continued before). The FIRST sentence ('only for an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal') has no violation to detect: the indicator is recognized only inside a literal, and every quotation symbol opens one of those three kinds (the premise of a negative case is not expressible).
